scripts.sync: node copy-to-www.js && npx cap sync android

scripts.build:release: node copy-to-www.js && npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew clean && ./gradlew assembleRelease bundleRelease && cd .. && cp android/app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk ./NammudeNaadu-release.apk && cp android/app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk ./app-release.apk && cp android/app/build/outputs/bundle/release/app-release.aab ./NammudeNaadu-release.aab
